name: Our Love
source:
Your closest friend pulls you into a gaming club and you know nothing about video games. Now her and her friends have to explain this to you.

[From [url=https://northiiee.itch.io/our-love-for-video-games]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你最亲近的朋友把你拉进了游戏社，而你对电子游戏一无所知。现在，她和朋友们必须向你解释电子游戏的一切。

（来源：[url=https://northiiee.itch.io/our-love-for-video-games]itch.io[/url]）
